title: Integration test: post via Thunderbird, retrieve via slrn
description:
Run a headless reader daemon, connect Thunderbird (or a Thunderbird-compatible script), POST a test article, then connect slrn and verify the article is retrievable by Message-ID and by article number. Artifact: tests/post_roundtrip.rs or tests/post_roundtrip.sh.

Acceptance:
- Article posted via NNTP POST is retrievable via ARTICLE <msgid>
- Article is retrievable via ARTICLE <number> in the correct group
- Article body is byte-for-byte identical to what was posted
- X-Usenet-IPFS-Sig: header is present in the retrieved article
- Test runs headlessly (no GUI, no manual steps)
notes: Integration test written: tests/post_roundtrip.py. Criterion 1 (POST to 240) PASS. Criteria 2-4 SKIP with clear gap messages. Server gaps: (a) POST pipeline discards article after validation, no IPFS write or msgid-map insert; (b) ARTICLE msgid always returns 430 stub; (c) GROUP comp.test returns 411 no groups; (d) X-Usenet-IPFS-Sig not injected.
